name: GetDimensions
caption: Get Dimensions

configuration.description: SmartField reference to the record, written as exactly one placeholder in double braces, e.g. "{{trigger_Rec}}" or "{{FindCustomers_results}}". An undotted name is looked up directly (an array reference such as {{FindX_results}} resolves to its first element); a dotted path (e.g. {{trigger_Rec.Customer}}) is walked through the SmartField definitions. Surrounding whitespace is ignored. Anything else fails at runtime. The table must have a 'Dimension Set ID' field.
Table number of the referenced record. The editor derives it from the reference; it must match the resolved record at runtime.
Dimensions to read. Each distinct code produces two value outputs.

items.description: Dimension code to read. Trimmed and upper-cased; duplicates and empty codes are ignored.
Written by the config canvas on repeater rows (10000, 20000, …); ignored by this step.

outputs.name: <DIMENSIONCODE>
outputs.when: one per configured dimension code (upper-cased): the dimension value code, '' if the record has no value for it

outputs.name: <DIMENSIONCODE>_Name
outputs.when: one per configured code: the dimension value name, '' if none

rules.check: configuration.reference must be non-empty (required field in the config canvas).
rules.message: Please fill in the highlighted fields.

rules.check: configuration.reference must be a single SmartField placeholder: after trimming it starts with '{{', ends with '}}' and has a non-empty name inside. Otherwise it cannot be resolved.
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: configuration.tableNo must be present and non-zero (missing, null or unreadable values count as 0). The editor derives it from the reference.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Get Dimensions step.
Table No. is required for a Get Dimensions step.

rules.check: Write tableNo as a JSON integer. A value that cannot be read as an integer is treated as 0.
rules.message: Table No. is required for a Get Dimensions step.

rules.check: The reference must resolve to a record reference in the flow context at run time, and the record must still exist (otherwise Business Central's standard 'record does not exist' error).
rules.message: Reference "%1" cannot be resolved to a record.

rules.check: The table of the resolved record must equal configuration.tableNo.
rules.message: Reference resolves to table %1 but the step is configured for table %2.

rules.check: The table must have a field named 'Dimension Set ID'.
rules.message: Table "%1" has no "Dimension Set ID" field, so dimensions cannot be set on it.

rules.check: dimensions should be a JSON array; other types produce no outputs.

notes: Output names are the trimmed, upper-cased dimension codes, two per distinct code in configuration order: {"name":"DEPARTMENT","type":"value"} and {"name":"DEPARTMENT_Name","type":"value"}. Reference them as {{slug_DEPARTMENT}} / {{slug_DEPARTMENT_Name}}.
A dimension code that does not exist, or has no value on the record, yields empty outputs (no error).
The step only reads. It has no 'rec' output and does not count as a writing step for the Confirm dialog publish warning.
The missing-field error message says 'set' because the text is shared with Set Dimension Values.
